@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@1200 • 1544@@casttime@@none@@cost@@50 / 55 / 60 / 65 / 70@@cooldown@@14 / 13 / 12 / 11 / 10@@targeting@@Unit@@damagetype@@Magic@@spellshield@@True@@projectile@@{{{projectile}}}@@notes@@ * The dash speed depends on the inverse of the distance to the target: ** If '''Alistar's''' [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|radius]] overlaps with his target's, he will dash with 1200 speed. ** If '''Alistar''' is further from his target than the previous condition, he will dash with (1200  ×  dash distance) / (dash distance - sum of radiuses). *** At maximum target range, against an enemy with a 65 [[File:Gameplay radius.png|20px|link=Unit size|An icon representing the keyword Gameplay radius]] [[:Unit size|gameplay radius]] (median of all champions), '''Alistar''' will dash with 1544 speed (reaching his target within 0.429 seconds). *** Both the lower the dash distance and the larger '''Alistar''' and/or his target, the faster the dash becomes; this scales hyperbolically (dash speed can theoretically scale up to ∞). * When [[File:Alistar Pulverize.png|20xpx|border|link=Alistar#Pulverize|An icon for Alistar's ability Pulverize]] [[Alistar#Pulverize|Pulverize]] is buffered during the dash, the knock back distance is reduced to 200 units. * The CC duration of the ability can be reduced by up to 33.33% [[File:Tenacity icon.png|20px|link=Tenacity|An icon representing the keyword Tenacity]] [[:Tenacity|Tenacity]], due to airborne not being reducible while the stun is. * The [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knockback]] direction is in a straight line from '''Alistar's''' original location at start of cast and the enemy when '''Alistar's''' dash ends. * ''Headbutt'' can knock enemies through terrain. The [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knockback]] stops short on walls that cannot be surpassed but the disable duration is not changed. * The [[spell indicator]] for this ability also displays the direction for the knock back relative to '''Alistar's''' position. * '''Alistar's''' [[File:Range icon.png|15px|link=Range]] attack range is reduced「 to -375 」「 by 500 」during ''Headbutt'', to prevent him from being able to attack the target when he completes the dash. * [[File:Unstoppable icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|An icon representing the keyword Displacement immune]] [[:Crowd control#Displacement_Immunity|Displacement immunity]] will not resist the application of the [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stun]].@@
